vulnerable_code:
class Recruiting::ResumesController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_recruiter!

  def show
    # Looks up ActiveStorage::Attachment directly by ID across all candidate profiles
    @attachment = ActiveStorage::Attachment.find_by!(id: params[:id], record_type: 'CandidateProfile')
    send_data @attachment.download, filename: @attachment.filename.to_s
  end
end
diagnosis: The show action queries ActiveStorage::Attachment by primary key id filtered only by record_type without verifying that the candidate applied to jobs owned by the recruiter's agency. Recruiters can harvest resumes containing candidate phone numbers, home addresses, and compensation histories from competing hiring pipelines.
exploit_request:
GET /api/recruiting/resumes/att_7731 HTTP/1.1
Host: ats.talentforce.net

corrected_code:
class Recruiting::ResumesController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_recruiter!

  def show
    profile = current_recruiter.agency.candidate_profiles.find(params[:candidate_profile_id])
    @attachment = profile.resume_attachment
    send_data @attachment.download, filename: @attachment.filename.to_s
  end
end
